e1wvyiv0w4wcl.speaker: keo
e1wvyiv0w4wcl.text: Today, for the first time, they've let me carve a devata — a celestial woman — all by myself. …But I don't know what kind of face to give her.

e16ul0zr1bzuv.speaker: keo
e16ul0zr1bzuv.text: Oh, you came back? …I still can't decide on her face.
e16ul0zr1bzuv.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

es4ee85usk3i.speaker: keo

ewztd0x1hi5u.speaker: narr

e1qbpg0p17laq.speaker: keo
e1qbpg0p17laq.text: There are hundreds — thousands — of devatas in this temple. But not one of them has the same face.
e1qbpg0p17laq.heard: There are hundreds — thousands — of devatas in this temple. But not one of them has the same face.

e16hx4232s3j8.speaker: keo
e16hx4232s3j8.text: The master always says, “Don't carve two alike. Carve each one like a living person.”

eflfe798g3u9.text: A smile… Okay, I'll try. I'll make her lips like my mom's when she smiles.

eam89t91vmib.speaker: keo

e17l88c7oc4sc.speaker: keo
e17l88c7oc4sc.text: You see, the stones are stacked into the wall first, and then we carve them right there. So if you make a mistake, you can't start over.

e12eiv1t8sdc5.speaker: keo
e12eiv1t8sdc5.text: This stone was brought here from a mountain far, far away, along canals. Thousands of people are building this temple, over decades.
e12eiv1t8sdc5.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1moruga15cvw.speaker: nekmax
e1moruga15cvw.text: The sandstone of Angkor Wat was cut at the foot of Mount Kulen, to the northeast. Researchers have found more than 50 quarries, and traces of a canal running straight toward the capital.
e1moruga15cvw.heard: The sandstone of Angkor Wat was cut at the foot of Mount Kulen, to the northeast. Researchers have found more than 50 quarries, and traces of a canal running straight toward the capital.

eu9spezpr780.speaker: keo
eu9spezpr780.text: This temple is for the god Vishnu. The king decided that, they say.
eu9spezpr780.heard: This temple is for the god Vishnu. The king decided that, they say.
eu9spezpr780.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e16ltz5e19kfl.speaker: keo
e16ltz5e19kfl.text: And this temple faces west. Most other temples face east.
e16ltz5e19kfl.heard: And this temple faces west. Most other temples face east.

ee78glj1cwoz.speaker: 親方
ee78glj1cwoz.text: Once in spring and once in autumn, there's a day when day and night are the same length. On that morning, if you look from the western approach, the sun rises over the central tower.

eq9mhzc1wjwc.speaker: 親方
eq9mhzc1wjwc.text: When you build a stone temple, you build the movement of the sky into it, too.
